about: Curated stops for the western Canada corridor (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba and southern BC fuel), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Built 2026-11-22 from osm-stops leads over the 2026-11-16 planet; BC rest areas come from canada-alaska.json (DataBC). lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it.
